summary: Learn board-level AI oversight, risk controls, and governance frameworks in 5 days. Build practical tools and reports for executive action.
lede: AI governance training helps board members and executives assess AI oversight, identify risks, and establish practical governance controls. It covers AI maturity assessment, oversight structures, risk registers, policy controls, and reporting, with practice creating governance artefacts and reviewing bias, explainability, and safety. Participants also learn to connect AI activity with risk and strategy in board-level reports.
audienceIntro: This course is built for leaders who oversee AI decisions, review risk exposure, and approve governance structures across the enterprise.
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of board or executive decision-making, governance processes, and basic AI concepts such as machine learning, model outputs, and data-driven automation. No coding or programming is required, but you should be comfortable reviewing policies, risk papers, dashboards, and executive briefs. Prior exposure to enterprise risk, compliance, audit, strategy, digital transformation, or technology oversight will help you move faster through the exercises. The course stays at conceptual and operational level for advanced AI governance topics, with hands-on practice focused on governance artefacts rather than technical model engineering.
